frequency_hz.note: Standard ARINC 708 / ITU aeronautical airborne X-band weather radar center frequency (9.345-9.375 GHz)

power_w.note: Assumed average X-band transmit power for C-17A AN/APS-133(V) weather & ground-mapping radar

peak_power_w.note: Assumed pulsed peak transmit power for C-17A AN/APS-133(V) weather & ground-mapping radar

peak_gain_dbi.note: Assumed flat-plate weather radar array peak gain (~0.45-0.75 m dish) for C-17A AN/APS-133(V) weather & ground-mapping radar

azimuth_limit_deg.note: Standard +/-60 deg forward airborne weather radar azimuth sweep

elevation_limit_deg.note: Standard +/-15 deg airborne weather radar antenna tilt range

beamwidth_deg.note: Assumed 3-dB pencil beamwidth for C-17A AN/APS-133(V) weather & ground-mapping radar

range_max_m.note: Standard ~160-180 nmi (300-320 km) airborne weather radar display range

mds_dbz_10km.note: Assumed minimum detectable precipitation reflectivity at 10 km reference range (Probert-Jones equation)

itu-p838.title: ITU-R Recommendation P.838-3 (Specific attenuation model for rain) & ARINC 708 airborne X-band weather radar allocation (9.3-9.5 GHz)
